mapper.select: SELECT address FROM watched_address WHERE chain_id = #{chainId}

SELECT w.id, w.chain_id, w.address, w.name, w.tag, w.note, COALESCE(s.swap_count, 0) AS swap_count, s.last_active_at, (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM w.created_at) * 1000)::bigint AS created_at_ms FROM watched_address w LEFT JOIN ( SELECT watched_address, COUNT(*) AS swap_count, MAX(block_timestamp) * 1000 AS last_active_at FROM swap WHERE chain_id = #{chainId} GROUP BY watched_address ) s ON s.watched_address = w.address WHERE w.chain_id = #{chainId} ORDER BY w.id DESC
